rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the process of breathing.

example.english: After exercising, my respiration is still rapid.
example.traditional: 做完運動之後，我嘅呼吸仲係好急促。
example.jyutping: zou6 jyun4 wan6 dung6 zi1 hau6 ngo5 ge3 fu1 kap1 zung6 hai6 hou2 gap1 cuk1

rows.note: Use this for one individual breath rather than breathing as an ongoing process.

example.english: I had to stop for one respiration after running.
example.traditional: 我跑到要停低抖一啖氣。
example.jyutping: ngo5 paau2 dou3 jiu3 ting4 dai1 dau2 jat1 daam6 hei3
